label: EV-01
command_argv:
set -e
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,subprocess
root=Path(".").resolve()
out=root/"docs/05_任务交接/P9_PRODUCT_AUTHORITATIVE_TRACE_MINIMUM_CONTRACT_V1/evidence/immutable_manifest.json"
paths=set()
for pattern in ("src/**/*","tests/**/*","scripts/**/*","samples/**/*"):
    for p in root.glob(pattern):
        if p.is_file() and "__pycache__" not in p.parts:
            paths.add(p)
for rel in (
    "docs/01_项目现状/PROJECT_BOTTLENECK_MAP.md",
    "docs/05_任务交接/P9_KNOWN_PAYMENT_ATTEMPT_PREFLIGHT_CAPABILITY_REVALIDATION_V1/REVIEW.md",
    "docs/05_任务交接/P9_PRODUCT_AUTHORITATIVE_TRACE_MINIMUM_CONTRACT_V1/CONTRACT.md",
):
    p=root/rel
    if p.is_file(): paths.add(p)
manifest={p.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(paths)}
out.write_text(json.dumps({"schema":"authoritative-trace-design-immutable-manifest/v1","head":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),"files":manifest},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
print("HEAD="+subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip())
print("MANIFEST_FILE_COUNT="+str(len(manifest)))
print("MANIFEST_SHA256="+hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
print("SRC_FILES="+str(sum(1 for x in manifest if x.startswith("src/"))))
print("TEST_FILES="+str(sum(1 for x in manifest if x.startswith("tests/"))))
print("SCRIPT_FILES="+str(sum(1 for x in manifest if x.startswith("scripts/"))))
print("SAMPLE_FILES="+str(sum(1 for x in manifest if x.startswith("samples/"))))
PY
printf "%s\n" "=== ROUTE ==="
grep -nE "task_id:|task_kind:|state:|current_role:|project_map_revision:|active_bottleneck_id:|hypothesis_id:|authorization_" CURRENT.md
printf "%s\n" "=== STATUS ==="
git -c core.quotePath=false status --short --branch
